name: qa-debug-companion
description: VS Code extension + dynamic MCP registration that holds Mocha on test failure for Copilot-driven QA investigation. Phase 1.

scripts.test:unit: pnpm -r run test:unit && pnpm --filter ./evals run qa-reporter-test-err
scripts.test:snapshot: pnpm --filter ./mocha-hooks run build && node --import tsx tools/snapshot-check.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:snapshot
scripts.test:s2: pnpm --filter ./mocha-hooks run build && node --import tsx tools/oracle.ts --decisions mark_passed,give_up --tests 'fixture-tests/specs/**/*.spec.js'
